data.name: Resin Secretion Gift
data.description: As a standard action, you can expel spittle that rapidly hardens into a resin. This effect is identical to the web spell with a caster level of %1, except it targets a single 5-foot space, has a hardness of 1, and has %2 hit points. Creatures caught in the spray can attempt a Reflex save (DC %3) to avoid the effect. The resin lasts for 1 minute before crumbling to dust.|HiveManifestationLevel|HiveManifestationLevel*2|10+TL/2+HiveManifestationLevel
